messages:
eli: FYI ran into a nasty UX with the new TypeScript Next starter (app-router + edge) while demoing today. Long SSE streams abort mid-way and the client hangs in a retry loop.
zoe: ugh, which starter branch + SDK?
eli: `next-ts-starter` main branch. package.json pins `@redwood/sdk-js@0.7.9` and the example also spins up a small edge API that proxies the /v1/stream response. Repro steps: `npm i`, set REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY (ephemeral workshop token), run `npm run dev`, open /playground and click "Stream Summary" on the 2MB doc. After ~70s the browser console shows a 401 then the frontend retries and gets 429s. UI spinner never stops.
rahim: that sounds like the classic mid-stream auth expiry. JS SDK recently added logic to abort retries on 401 during an active SSE, but I think the edge proxy code here re-issues the request on error. Could be starter wiring + pinned SDK mismatch.
eli: here's the minimal edge handler from the starter: ```js
// app/api/summary/route.ts (Edge)
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const r = await fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: req.url }),
    duplex: "half"
  });
  return new Response(r.body, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream" } });
}
```
zoe: ta. Two fixes: 1) starter should warn about ephemeral tokens for edge previews and recommend REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN for local dev OR include a token-proxy refresh pattern; 2) bump the SDK in the starter and add a TTL preflight check that aborts streaming with a clear message if TTL < 120s.
rahim: I opened ISSUE-820 to track parity/edge behavior. SDK-team note: ensure Node/edge runtime honors the ``abort-on-401-during-stream`` guard and expose config `streamRetryPolicy: { abortOn401: true }` so server teams can opt-in/out. Also add telemetry counter `stream_auth_abort` so workshops show up in telemetry.
infra-bot: ISSUE-820 created and assigned to @rahim.
eli: short-term I opened a tiny PR to the starter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-ts-starter/pull/45 — it: updates README, adds a preflight TTL check in the playground client, and bumps `@redwood/sdk-js` to `0.8.3-rc`. The preflight abort UI now shows "Token expires too soon for interactive streams — refresh or use a dev token."
zoe: can you add a graceful client message instead of spinner? even a small banner helps.
eli: done in the PR — catches `StreamClosedError` and shows a clear banner with a link to the token refresh docs. Also added a short-circuit so we don't re-issue requests if a 401 is detected mid-stream.
rahim: long-term: add an eval harness test under eng-ml/evals/ts-stream-auth-expiry that runs a mocked SSE and forces a 401 at t=60s and asserts the SDK surfaces AuthenticationError and stops retrying. I'll own adding that to nightly.
preview-bot: Preview deploy for pr-45: https://preview.redwood.dev/next-ts-starter/pr-45 ready :rocket:
eli: validated locally with a 90s stream and ephemeral token TTL=60s. Before PR the client would loop; after PR the playground aborts with a clear "Auth expired during stream" message and suggests steps. Workshop attendees were much less confused.
zoe: SDK owners: can we cut a non-rc patch with the abort-on-401 behavior for Node & Edge? We should avoid leaving the rc in starters for long.
rahim: yes I'll coordinate a patch release (0.8.3) and backport telemetry. Also will add a config variable for server-side workflows that want legacy retry behavior.
eli: thanks — leaving a note in the starter README and the workshop slide deck to recommend token lifetimes and the proxy pattern. This should reduce support tickets during sessions. :thumbsup:
